lines.en: Grandma, this picture has only shapes.
Yes. Big geometric shapes and bold colors.
lines.ko: 그러네요. 큰 기하학적 모양과 대담한 색이 있어요.

lines.en: What is the meaning of this, Grandma?
I am not sure. What do you feel?
lines.ko: 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 어떤 느낌이 들어요?

lines.en: It feels like happy chaos to me.
That's a good answer. No wrong answer here.
lines.ko: 좋은 대답이에요. 여기에는 틀린 답이 없어요.

lines.en: Are these lines random, Grandma?
I don't know. Last week I saw a minimal room.
lines.ko: 저도 몰라요. 지난주에 아주 단순한 방을 봤어요.

lines.en: Was it an installation, Grandma?
Yes. Thank you for asking. We will go together.
lines.ko: 네. 물어봐 줘서 고마워요. 우리 같이 가 볼 거예요.

dialogs.about: 현대미술 전시장에서 친구와 벽화 앞에 서서

lines.en: Hi! This wall has spray paint on it.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 이 벽에는 스프레이 물감이 뿌려져 있어요.

lines.en: Yes! Is that art or just color?
I think it is art. What do you think?
Me too. The bold lines feel free.
That room over there is very minimal.
The white installation looks quiet and clean.
lines.ko: 하얀 설치 미술이 조용하고 깨끗해 보여요.

lines.en: Last month I did not understand abstraction.
And now? Do you feel the concept?
A little. I just enjoy the colors now.
Good. We will visit the next room together.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 우리 다음 방도 같이 볼 거예요.
